reason: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and I'm watching every dollar. Even the $24.99 launch price is about what I already pay for something I know, and I'd wait for a flash sale or a coupon.
objection: I can get a month of magnesium for $19 to $23 from brands I've heard of, so paying more for an unknown brand doesn't add up on a price-per-day basis.
would_change_my_mind: A flash sale or coupon bringing one box to around $18 to $19, or a cheap trial box so I can try it before committing.
